blocks.text: STA. BARBARA, Pangasinan – Three cousins aged 4, 5 and 6 drowned in a pond in Barangay Payas, Santa Barbara on Saturday. The lifeless bodies of children were discovered at 5:20 p.m. by a farmer and resident of Barangay Cablong, who searched the area after he found their clothes near a swamp. Municipal Disaster Risk
